briefdescription.para: Set of macros to dispatch atomic functions.

detaileddescription.para: These macros select the atomic function variant based on the argument type, for example, vatomic_read(a) calls vatomic32_read(a) if a is a vatomic32_t and calls vatomic64_read(a) if a is a vatomic64_t. vatomicptr_t is mapped to either 32 or 64 bits functions depending on the architecture.
